title: Guido Rangone to Anne de Montmorency, Venice, 10 Jan 1530 (BnF fr. 3070 f. 81, DECODE R4249) and 24 Dec 1529 (BnF fr. 3082 f. 42)

steps.what: Tomokiyo francis.htm: Rangone ciphers in Clair. 330 f. 206 and Clair. 331 f. 15, undeciphered, same cipher; GL.htm has no Rangone key.
DECODE R4249 8 images with the project cookie; Clair. 331 view 15 and Clair. 330 view 210 from Gallica.
Clair. copy headings 'Vol. 134 fol. 81' / 'Vol. 143 fol. 42' give Béthune volume numbers; Gallica SRU search located fr. 3082 no. 19 (the 24 Dec 1529 original), view 65.
Both originals transcribed sign by sign (cipher.txt, 264 signs), checked against the copies.
Repository keys of Italians in French service 1528-29 (Visconti, Bizozola, Sormano, Gramont) compared by sign set.
Homophonic annealing against it-cinquecento 5-gram (solve.py): degenerate 'iiii' optimum, then pseudo-Italian with no consensus after adding a frequency penalty.
Genuine Italian of the letter's clear text scores -1.72 per 5-gram vs -2.3 for the solver's best: search failure, not model failure.

Incremental-delta annealer (solve2.py), 40 restarts x 2M moves: one restart at -1.97 reads 'malissimo satisfato di lui', 'mandato a dirlo al signore Cesare', 'il Fregoso', 'una pratica di lei mi dispiacera'; perturbed restarts return to it.
Subagent checked four other Rangone letters of 1529-30 (fr. 3012, 3013, 3034, 2980): all clear; Joachin 1529 cipher (fr. 3012 no. 51) is a different system.
Hand corrections from words: 6=h, tailed sign=f (oferte), D=b (ben disposte), vt null; three look-alike sign pairs split after re-inspection.
DBI Fregoso: married Rangone's sister autumn 1529, commanded Ravenna/Cervia for Venice, made governor of Verona by the Senate Jan 1530 (the 'grande oferte').
Word-aware scoring (spaced.py): coordinate ascent and pair brute force over the rare signs; no alternative beats noise, null option deletes letters.
reading.md: 232/264 cipher signs read as sense (87.9%).

A1 'instantia [y S] de ven[i]re': the cipher has no separate 'a' after instantia; y S conjectured 'me' (grade I, from the clear lead-in 'caso acaduto mi'), printed '[a m]e'. A2 'o[y] le mie': every single-letter value for y tried by hand, none gives Italian; left open. Counts unchanged.

Re-transcription of the open stretches from Gallica natives (fr. 3070 = btv1b9059934c view 127; fr. 3082 view 65) at full resolution. B3 sign d is a cursive theta (i), so 'volse r[c d 9]a' = 'r?i?a', which the corpus fills only as 'ruina' (123 vs next 14): c=u, 9=n by the word. A1/A2 y confirmed one sign; A6 X found straight-stroked, unlike A2's cursive x; B4 sign after xi has a back-loop. 'piu volse' has one u sign for both words.

The old 87.9% was a hand count by phrase (e.g. 7 signs for A2's one open sign y). New measure.py counts per sign, a sign read only inside a corpus word (it-cinquecento corpora, >=3 hits) or a listed spelling: 245/264 = 92.8% (A 134/149 = 89.9%, B 111/115 = 96.5%). Below 95%: A6 (12 signs) is the block.

outcome.method_basis: The homophonic key was rebuilt ciphertext-only from this letter (fr. 3070 f. 81) and a same-cipher sibling found here (fr. 3082 f. 42, via Tomokiyo's Clairambault references); no prior reading exists (Tomokiyo lists both as undeciphered).
outcome.notes: Both passages concern Cesare Fregoso, Rangone's brother-in-law: Venice's offers to him (A) and his action 'con spada et cappa' (B). Open signs occur once each; the two letters are all the ciphertext known.

gaps.item: A1 'instantia [y S] de ven[i]re' and A2 'loro [y] le mie' (3 signs)
gaps.detail: y occurs twice; re-inspected at full resolution, same sign both places; 'me' fits A1, no letter fits A2; S occurs once
xo occurs once; the X of A6 is straight-stroked, not the cursive x (c) of A2, so 'icon' is itself doubtful; no corpus match for any value
sign a occurs once; 'ben', 'Gen(ova)' both fit
the B4 sign has a back-loop unlike A4's tailed f; occurs once

outcome.fraction_read_source: targets/rangone1530/measure.py: word-segmented reading aligned sign by sign with the key decrypt; a sign counts only inside a word with no open sign that occurs >=3 times in the it-cinquecento corpora or is a listed single-consonant/missing-sign spelling (245 of 264)

prior.where: DECODE Non-decrypted; Tomokiyo (cryptiana francis.htm) lists both Clairambault copies as undeciphered; no key on Lasry's GL.htm; no edition found
